a.label: CRADA between U.S. Army Ground Vehicle Systems Center and To The Stars Academy

edges.label: a non-FAR instrument binding the Army to a private claimant of recovered material
edges.note: Signed 10 October 2019 by the Director of the Army Ground Vehicle Systems Center and announced 17 October 2019. A Cooperative Research and Development Agreement sits outside ordinary procurement, involves no exchange of appropriated funds to the partner, and protects the private party's proprietary data - which is exactly the class of vehicle this domain is about. The executed document is not public; sourcing is the partner's own contemporaneous FAQ.
